content.short: sTONks is a professional trading bot and analytics tool on TON featuring anti-rug and sniping modes.
content.description: sTONks Analytics is a sophisticated trading utility designed to provide TON users with a competitive edge in the decentralized markets. Operating primarily through a high-speed Telegram bot, it offers professional-grade features such as automated sniping, anti-rug protection, and real-time PnL monitoring for various Jettons. sTONks provides deep analytical insights into liquidity trends and whale activity, helping traders make data-driven decisions while minimizing risk. It is an essential tool for active participants in the fast-moving and often complex TON DeFi landscape.
